newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania plans to open Koipe's capital.
newsitem.headline: Eridania plans to open Koipe's capital.

text.p: Franco-Italian food group Eridania Beghin-Say plans to soon open the capital of its Spanish oil unit Koipe to the public but intends to retain a majority stake in the company, chairman Stefano Meloni said on Friday.
"We wish to increase the liquidity of the stock while retaining a majority stake," Meloni told a group of reporters after a news conference on the group's 1996 earnings.
Meloni said the operation could take place in the coming months. But he said Eridania had not yet decided how much capital it would retain.
"It could be 60-65 percent or 50-55 percent, that has not been decided," he said.
He also specified Eridania would not make a capital gain from the sale, adding its impact for the group would be "neutral".
At end-December Eridania bought a 9.66 percent stake in Koipe from Spain's Tabacalera, bringing its total stake in Koipe to 75.95 percent.
